requirement: HWP5-to-HWP5 inter-document structured clipboard transfer with destination identity, DocInfo/style and BinData remapping, exact body ownership, source immutability, and atomic refusal.

clipboardEnvelope.format: Standalone HWP5 CFB fragment, one selected body control per operation
clipboardEnvelope.validation: One section, one control-only paragraph, exact generated section/column controls, existing paragraph-block reference and ownership validation, reachable BinData only; unsupported/ambiguous structures rejected.

implementation.remapping: Existing paragraph-block staged importer carries referenced DocInfo/styles/paragraph shapes/character shapes and BinData into destination-owned IDs; object and picture IDs are allocated without destination aliases. All fallible parsing/resource/ID staging completes before destination mutation.
implementation.t009PictureIdentity: Preserve nonzero HWP5 Picture component instance IDs and admit new ones only when document-wide unique; zero remains valid.
